sources: Two-page local MCP production records and author feedback on the adopted manuscript, story-specific outfit sheets and review of targeted edits.
Comparison of the release baseline, the two changed skill files, the existing agent metadata, and recent one- and multipage feedback.

findings.observation: The story required different costumes and the initial production lacked the matching sheet.
findings.rule: Approve and assign the actual outfit sheet before drawing affected story pages.
findings.reason: A costume description cannot serve as the adopted visual reference. Reuse a matching approved sheet when available.

findings.observation: A correctly attributed balloon did not establish that the character looked at the intended listener.
findings.rule: Specify the target in the drawing instructions and review the face and visible eyeline separately from balloon attribution.
findings.reason: Speech attribution and direction of attention express different parts of dialogue.

findings.observation: A local edit can preserve the panel rectangle while the art within it shrinks.
findings.rule: Compare the border and artwork at original scale and page size, including unintended interior bands and double frames.
findings.reason: The check preserves intended borders and negative space without forcing whole-page rerenders.

findings.observation: A visible shoulder connection attracted author feedback.
findings.rule: Follow the existing visible shoulder, sleeve and arm review and compare the adopted correction.
findings.reason: The anatomy check already addresses the observation and permits natural occlusion.

findings.observation: A specific scene needed to keep the speaker outside the pictured area.
findings.rule: Retain each scene’s framing and put any general rule change through separate review.
findings.reason: The approved release scope consists of the three previously reviewed skill changes.

checks.name: Linked production instructions and agent metadata
checks.evidence: Verified both new cross-reference targets, eyeline wording, adopted-sheet reuse and the existing user approval order and local production operations.

checks.name: Application behavior boundary
checks.evidence: The application source differs from v8.2.2 only by the release display version. MCP runtime and generation behavior are unchanged.
